notes: Read all 377 source lines before editing and preserved LogStreamLevel, LogStreamEvent, UseLogStreamOptions, UseLogStreamResult, LOG_STREAM_MAX_EVENTS, LOG_STREAM_PATH, parseSSEChunk, buildLogEvent, buildLogStreamUrl, clear, pause, enabled, drop counting, and rolling-buffer behavior.

Ported the fetch-based SSE stream to native-compatible TypeScript by using the native apiUrl helper, global fetch injection, AbortController cleanup, global requestAnimationFrame batching when available, and a microtask fallback for tests or runtimes without frame scheduling.

Avoided DOM-only window and DOMException usage; when the React Native fetch runtime cannot expose a ReadableStream body or UTF-8 byte decoder support, the hook reports an explicit Error via its existing error state instead of silently pretending the stream is connected.
